QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_13

question.text: As per Ch 9, the typical upper cap on one-time Set-up/Organisational Costs charged by the Investment Manager to an AIF's investors is:

answer.text: 1.5% to 2.5% of total capital commitments, amortized over 36 months or fund life from first closing
No cap — set-up costs are borne actuals

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that set-up or organisational expenses can go up to 1.5% or 2.5% of total capital commitments raised and can be amortized over 36 months or over the fund life from first closing. The Trap: Option A is egregiously high. Option C is absurd. Option D confuses set-up costs with transaction expenses, which are borne on actuals without limit. Note: Remember both the cap (1.5%-2.5% of commitments) and the amortisation period (36 months or fund life from first close).
